BETA Close X Hikma Pharmaceuticals Plc has purchased 589,000 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange between August 3rd and August 7th, 2026, as part of its $250 million share repurchase program. The average price paid was approximately 1,680.96 pence per share. The company intends to cancel these repurchased shares, and following these transactions, Hikma will have 209,572,695 ordinary shares in issue. Disclaimer* Hikma Pharmaceuticals Plc 10 August 2026 HIKMA PHARMACEUTICALS PLC TRANSACTIONS IN OWN SHARES Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC (LSE: HIK) (NasdaqDubai: HIK) (LEI: 549300BNS685UXH4JI75) (the '' Company '') announces that, during the period from 3 August 2026 to 7 August 2026 (inclusive) (the '' Disclosure Period ''), it purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each through J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of the second tranche (which commenced on 27 May 2026) of its $250 million share repurchase programme announced on 26 February 2026 (the '' Buyback Programme ''). Date within Disclosure Period Trading Venue Aggregate number of ordinary shares repurchased Lowest price paid(pence) Highest price paid (pence) Volume-weighted average price (pence) 3 August 2026 XLON 117,524 1,568.0000 1,591.0000 1,579.9551 4 August 2026 XLON 117,635 1,571.0000 1,598.0000 1,586.2105 5 August 2026 XLON 118,380 1,564.0000 1,597.0000 1,583.3615 6 August 2026 XLON 97,148 1,644.0000 1,754.0000 1,720.8368 7 August 2026 XLON 118,824 1,673.0000 1,721.0000 1,693.2764 The Company intends to cancel the repurchased shares. Since the launch of the Buyback Programme on 26 February 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 12,313,758 ordinary shares at a total cost of £172,712,762.59. The Company holds 12,833,233 of its ordinary shares in treasury. Following the settlement of the above transactions and cancellation of the repurchased shares, the Company will have 209,572,695 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares) and the total number of voting rights in the Company will therefore be 209,572,695.
